sections.heading: Pathways For Children And Youth - Center Overview

blocks.text: Maltby Centre is an accredited, full-service agency that has been providing mental health services to children, youth, and young adults in Ontario for over 25 years. The agency has five campuses located in Kingston, Napanee, Northbrook, Sharbot Lake, and Sydenham, Ontario. Maltby Centre is the lead agency for children’s and youth mental health services in Kingston, Frontenac, Lennox & Addington. The agency works closely with partner agencies to ensure successful service navigation and provides care to clients in one of their campuses, in their homes, in schools, or in other community locations. Maltby Centre was originally established as Pathways for Children & Youth in 1996 and was renamed in 2018 in honor of its founding director, JoAnne Maltby. Today, Maltby Centre still operates under JoAnne’s vision and strives to create possibilities for change in young people’s lives.

centre.about_html:
Pathways for Children and Youth is a public rehabilitation center based in Kingston, Ontario that specializes in treating mental health issues, substance abuse, drug and alcohol addiction. They provide a wide range of therapies and amenities to help people overcome their addiction and improve their mental health.

The center offers evidence-based practices, holistic therapy, yoga, and meditation as well as nutritional counseling, art and nature therapy, individual therapy and counseling, family therapy and counseling, and group therapy and counseling. These approaches are designed to address the physical, emotional, and psychological aspects of addiction, giving patients the tools they need to overcome their challenges and build a new life for themselves.

Pathways for Children and Youth also offers 12-step programs, family services, and outpatient drug rehab services. These programs provide patients with the support they need to achieve lasting recovery and develop healthy relationships with their loved ones.

If you or someone you know is struggling with mental health issues or substance abuse, Pathways for Children and Youth is here to help. Their team of professionals is dedicated to helping patients overcome their addiction and improve their overall quality of life. Contact them today to learn more about their services and how they can help you on your journey to recovery.

raw_html:
Pathways for Children and Youth is a public rehabilitation center based in Kingston, Ontario that specializes in treating mental health issues, substance abuse, drug and alcohol addiction. They provide a wide range of therapies and amenities to help people overcome their addiction and improve their mental health.

The center offers evidence-based practices, holistic therapy, yoga, and meditation as well as nutritional counseling, art and nature therapy, individual therapy and counseling, family therapy and counseling, and group therapy and counseling. These approaches are designed to address the physical, emotional, and psychological aspects of addiction, giving patients the tools they need to overcome their challenges and build a new life for themselves.

Pathways for Children and Youth also offers 12-step programs, family services, and outpatient drug rehab services. These programs provide patients with the support they need to achieve lasting recovery and develop healthy relationships with their loved ones.

If you or someone you know is struggling with mental health issues or substance abuse, Pathways for Children and Youth is here to help. Their team of professionals is dedicated to helping patients overcome their addiction and improve their overall quality of life. Contact them today to learn more about their services and how they can help you on your journey to recovery.

Pathways For Children And Youth - Center Overview

Maltby Centre is an accredited, full-service agency that has been providing mental health services to children, youth, and young adults in Ontario for over 25 years. The agency has five campuses located in Kingston, Napanee, Northbrook, Sharbot Lake, and Sydenham, Ontario. Maltby Centre is the lead agency for children’s and youth mental health services in Kingston, Frontenac, Lennox & Addington. The agency works closely with partner agencies to ensure successful service navigation and provides care to clients in one of their campuses, in their homes, in schools, or in other community locations. Maltby Centre was originally established as Pathways for Children & Youth in 1996 and was renamed in 2018 in honor of its founding director, JoAnne Maltby. Today, Maltby Centre still operates under JoAnne’s vision and strives to create possibilities for change in young people’s lives.
